title: Consolidation: The Three Ts: Censorship, Aczél's Cultural Policy & Samizdat

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can sum up how the 'three Ts' worked and how samizdat publishing began in Hungary.
I can deploy agent-backgrounding structures (institutional 3rd plural, -ra/-re kerül, evaluative predicates, middle verbs, and nominalization).
I can talk about censorship, coded language and samizdat publishing in Hungarian.
